name: Mercenary Shield
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Shield (players/paladin/mercenary/shield_merc.sval, 17 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 5 (in brackets): arc 90° (160°); block 5 physical (25). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: The shield covers a 90° arc instead of 160°, and its 25% block stops only 5 physical damage.
